segments.sn35.10:1.3: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītesu rūpesu anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn35.10:1.5: paccuppannānaṃ rūpānaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.sn35.10:1.6: Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā aniccā atītānāgatā;
segments.sn35.10:1.12: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītesu dhammesu anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn35.10:1.14: paccuppannānaṃ dhammānaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotī”ti.
